# VISTA ESP32-C3 Sentinel Firmware
# Build system: ESP-IDF v5.2+
#
# Build commands:
#   idf.py set-target esp32c3
#   idf.py menuconfig   (optional: adjust flash size, BLE, etc.)
#   idf.py build
#   idf.py flash monitor
#
# Dependencies declared in main/CMakeLists.txt (auto-generated by ESP-IDF
# build system if not present; works with just this project-level file)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

# Detect IDF_PATH — required for build
if(NOT DEFINED ENV{IDF_PATH})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "IDF_PATH environment variable not set. "
            "Source export.sh from your ESP-IDF installation.")
endif()

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
project(vista-esp32)

# ── SDKCONFIG defaults (override in menuconfig) ──────────────────────
#
# Recommended sdkconfig settings for this project:
#   CONFIG_BT_ENABLED=y
#   CONFIG_BT_BLUEDROID_ENABLED=y
#   CONFIG_BT_BLE_ENABLED=y              (ESP32-C3: BLE only, no classic BT)
#   CONFIG_BT_NIMBLE_ENABLED=n           (use Bluedroid, not NimBLE)
#   CONFIG_BTDM_CTRL_MODE_BLE_ONLY=y     (BLE-only controller mode saves RAM)
#   CONFIG_FREERTOS_HZ=100               (10 ms tick for 100 ms polling)
#   CONFIG_PM_ENABLE=y                   (power management)
#   CONFIG_FREERTOS_USE_TICKLESS_IDLE=y  (lower power when idle)
#   CONFIG_ESP_SLEEP_DEEP_SLEEP_WAKEUP_DELAY=2000  (2 ms wakeup delay)
#
# The file sdkconfig.defaults (in this directory) can pre-set these:
#   CONFIG_BT_ENABLED=y
#   CONFIG_BT_BLUEDROID_ENABLED=y
#   CONFIG_BTDM_CTRL_MODE_BLE_ONLY=y
#   CONFIG_BT_BLE_50_FEATURES_SUPPORTED=n
#   CONFIG_PM_ENABLE=y
